# Area Under the Deficit Curve

```{r, fig.height=5.5, fig.width=9}
if (!is.null(analysis$segments) && nrow(analysis$segments) > 0) {
  # One representative drought series per variable: the shaded area is a
  # per-series quantity and overlaying every plant makes it unreadable.
  seg <- analysis$segments
  pick <- seg[seg$treatment %in% c("Drought", "drought"), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(pick) == 0) pick <- seg
  first_rep <- sort(unique(pick$replicate))[1]
  pick <- pick[pick$replicate == first_rep, , drop = FALSE]

  rehydra::plot_deficit_auc(pick, facet_by = c("genotype", "variable"))
}
```

# Memory Across Cycles

```{r}
if (!is.null(analysis$memory_trend) && nrow(analysis$memory_trend) > 0) {
  dplyr::select(
    analysis$memory_trend,
    dplyr::any_of(c("genotype", "treatment", "variable", "metric", "n_cycles",
                    "slope", "slope_conf_low", "slope_conf_high", "p_value",
                    "p_value_adj", "monotonic_fraction", "memory_class"))
  )
} else {
  cat("At least two segmented cycles are needed to fit a memory trend.\n")
}
```

```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=9}
if (!is.null(analysis$memory_trend) && nrow(analysis$memory_trend) > 0) {
  rehydra::plot_memory_trend(analysis$resilience, analysis$memory_trend)
}
```

# Short Scientific Interpretation

```{r}
mem <- analysis$memory
if (nrow(mem) > 0) {
  pos_rt <- sum(mem$Mem_Rt > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  pos_rc <- sum(mem$Mem_Rc > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat("Groups with positive resistance memory:", pos_rt, "\n")
  cat("Groups with positive recovery memory:", pos_rc, "\n")
}

trend <- analysis$memory_trend
if (!is.null(trend) && nrow(trend) > 0 && "memory_class" %in% names(trend)) {
  tab <- table(trend$memory_class)
  for (nm in names(tab)) {
    cat("Index-by-group trends classified as ", nm, ": ", tab[[nm]], "\n", sep = "")
  }
}

shape <- analysis$curve_shape
if (!is.null(shape) && nrow(shape) > 0 && "recovery_censored" %in% names(analysis$recovery_period)) {
  n_cens <- sum(analysis$recovery_period$recovery_censored, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (n_cens > 0) {
    cat("Right-censored recoveries (series ended before the threshold): ",
        n_cens, " of ", nrow(analysis$recovery_period), "\n", sep = "")
  }
}
```
